story.purpose: Chapter 9 ended on 'home is the distance you can keep alive.' Chapter 10 is the discovery that one thing inside that distance was never home's to give. The second hearth's core runs on a bonded cell — an issued component: not dug, not grown, not salvaged, not fabricable. The first need a world cannot answer sends the player back to the wreck, to the one channel that never closed, to ask — and the answer comes back before the asking finishes. A bearing is issued; the going is the player's. The run ends at the threshold: the station resolved from a point of light into a place, never entered. The station is never the actor. The player asks, claims, flies, and stops.
story.emotionalBefore: Settled; quiet ownership. The home is finished and working, and the ch9 close is intact: home is the distance you can keep alive.
story.emotionalAfter: Scale and smallness, then threshold restraint: the run ends with the station as a shape and the player outside it. Hand-back to free play happens in space, station visible, bearing held; the player may proceed no further (no dock affordance exists this run) or turn for home. Home continues; the ch9 close survives with a third light added to its geometry.
story.intendedAmbiguity: Who issues issued components, and why a pattern 'is not held'; the reply's speed (the pillar spend) and whether 'on record' means the network already knew what she would ask; and whose light it is — 'a light someone else keeps alive' reads naively as other people living there and deducibly as the network keeping its own lights, 'someone else' being a self-description she cannot yet parse. ST-0 itself is ambiguous by law: a route intelligence sees a schedule; a new player sees a satellite. Both are correct.

ST-0 LAW: no marker, no cue, no caption, no name — in this run ST-0 is never acknowledged in any register, by any lane. The player's connection of dot to bearing to place is made by geometry alone. ST-0 is deliberately not a shot and not on the signed AV rail: it is world state with an evidence point (capture.st0.sighting), and it may never acquire an anchor or a cue. ST-0 gets zero copy in any register.

ST-0 SPEC: ST0_TRANSIT_PERIOD_SECONDS = 90; uniform ellipse rate 2π/90 ≈ 0.070 rad/s = 7.0× SKY_STARFIELD_DRIFT_RAD_PER_SEC (0.01) and ~8.7× the companion drift (0.008); ellipse amplitudes longitude 1.0 rad (±57°), latitude 0.6 rad (±34°), centered on the true bearing; from p1's −6.8° mean the track peaks at ~+27° elevation and is above a ~7° terrain horizon for ≈40% of each loop, giving ~36–40s visible crossing per 90s period. Clamp ST0_MIN_PIXELS = 2.4 (the shipped MIN_BEACON_PIXELS precedent), never exceeding ~3 px at any tier/DPR/viewport; luminance above the brightest star, well below the moon; warm sodium-family amber, constant-luminance (no pulse, no blink — a blink is a cue and cues are forbidden), unlabeled, no distance readout, no look-at response, night-only. One billboard quad (MeshBasicMaterial, existing material class, no new shader), ≤1 draw call, placed by companionCelestialPlacement along the true active-planet-to-station direction so the ground track and the flown bearing are the same fact by construction; mounts on BOTH story worlds.

ST-0 RECURRENCE (re-derived at DAY_LENGTH_SECONDS 240, night ≈119s, ST0_TRANSIT_PERIOD_SECONDS 90, visible arc ≈40s): every night contains ≥1 ST-0 rise with worst-case ≥29s of visible arc before dawn extinction (worst start 90s into the night); any two consecutive nights contain ≥1 complete horizon-to-horizon crossing — the nightly start-offset advances 60s (240 mod 90), so two truncating starts (offset >79s) cannot occur consecutively (79–90 and its +60 shift 49–60 mod 90 are disjoint). Trace acceptance: ≥3 consecutive periods proven by phase telemetry (visibility-independent, may span day); the strip images one full crossing within a single night, and the probe may dwell under open sky through that night — the walk itself (≈8s) is the perception seed, not the capture window.

ST-0 EGRESS RULE (CN-N3, accepted in chapter-recon-02): the movie shelter egress face opens at ch10-cold entry only while the face is outside the movie camera's frustum (probe-assertable), with ≥1s between removal and the autopilot's first step so no strip frame straddles the change; the movie photographs neither the scaffolding nor its absence — the first outdoor frame is composed by the walk.

ST-0 IN-FRUSTUM VERIFIER OBLIGATION (CH-Q3/CN-N3 rider): the night-walk verifier trace must log an st0-in-frustum flag across the walk. If geography defeats the guarantee, the repair lane is autopilot path/idle-gaze shaping — when ST-0 is above the horizon, the autopilot's gaze target biases toward the true station bearing between goal-critical look demands, gated on isAutopilotDriving(), movie-lane only, zero manual-play effect. No camera grab in free play: ST-0 acquiring a forced look would be ST-0 acquiring a cue, and the no-cue law is absolute. The gaze bias is implemented only if the unbiased trace fails.

LIFECYCLE INVARIANT — one-shot enter, no double-enter: within a beat, objectives replace on progress (shipped pattern); no objective id spans a beat boundary — each beat enters with a fresh id, so the ch9 clear-then-reactivate double-enter shape is impossible in ch10 by construction. One objective-enter cue per activation; completion acknowledged by caption + work-order clear + score move (shipped grammar); no progress-cue type is invented.

LIFECYCLE INVARIANT — marker gating: all markers resolve from existing handles (habitat core, fabricator, hatch, flight targets, wreckRelayHandle); no marker-requiring objective is published before its handle exists (the ch9-settle scan-waterline 4s gap must not recur). Quit-to-menu mid-beat resumes at the beat per the ladder; beat change clears all guidance; ST-0 is world state, not cutscene state, and never clears.

ENTRY MECHANISM: ch10 is a re-activation from done. The fault is noticed, not announced: no event fires anywhere the player is not. Conditions are durable storyComplete + twoWorldHandoff set (shipped); accumulated done free-play time ≥ CH10_FREEPLAY_GRACE_SECONDS (named constant, owner-tunable — the 'do not rush' dial); local nightfall band entered on Tidegarden; player within CH10_HEARTH_NOTICE_RADIUS of the second hearth. The camera refuses all acknowledgment of the answer and the score uses no sting and no accent — two media, one law.

agencyWindows.mandatoryPath: ST-0 PRELUDE, THE UNMARKED FREE-PLAY TERM. cinematography.thesis: The player has been looking at the seam of light all along. From the ground, the station's dark hull is invisible against a dark sky and mostly below the horizon; what crosses the night is the amber of its kept lights, compressed by distance into a dot. The transit does not introduce a new image — it adds parallax to an old one: dot (ST-0, a fact of the sky), then the same amber stretched into a line as the atmosphere stops hiding it (seam), then the line yawed into a place (resolve). One color, one object, three distances, three levels of commitment — sight, information, scale — realized as a single continuous luminance object. No letterbox anywhere; the run's only camera intervention is 2.5 seconds of cold engines. The rejected alternative, Treatment B ('the instrument reveal'), spends the sky, converts perception into UI, and makes the reveal an authored moment in a run whose law is that the station never acts and the camera never takes.
